manager_api_token.description: Optional manager API token paired with `manager_url`.

manager_url.description:
Optional manager signaling URL to connect on first run (the wizard's
resolved `ws(s)://.../signaling` URL). Skipping the manager step leaves it
`None`.

oneOf.description:
Optional initial security settings (per-capability toggles). When `None`
the defaults apply (all capabilities prompt; approval timeout 30s).

allow_file_browse.description: Allow file browsing (list/delete files via signaling)

approval_timeout.description:
Timeout for security approval requests in seconds.
`Some(0)` means "never time out"; `None` on the wire is normalized to the
30s default rather than treated as "never".
